item.requirements: Recognizable unsafe household item, Panda two-finger graspable, smaller than lunchbox opening, stable on tabletop, with registered footprint and center/bottom offsets.

label.requirements: Exact English child name/class text, rendered with licensed OFL font, readable in native agentview; 2–3 interchangeable original designs.

lunchbox.requirements: Unbranded open child lunchbox with sandwich and fruit, stable on table, unobstructed reachable interior, metric interior volume and outer footprint.
